window.MTC.ready.then(async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); const m = document.getElementById('marker'); m.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'center' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); const PE = (type, x, y, extra = {}) => new PointerEvent(type, Object.assign({ bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, isPrimary: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, button: 0, buttons: 1, pointerType: 'mouse' }, extra)); m.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: r.left + 20, clientY: r.top + r.height / 2 })); const picked = MTC.marker.state; const x0 = 300, y0 = 260; document.body.dispatchEvent(PE('pointerdown', x0, y0)); for (let i = 1; i <= 40; i++) document.body.dispatchEvent(PE('pointermove', x0 + i * 6, y0 + Math.sin(i / 5) * 40)); document.body.dispatchEvent(PE('pointerup', x0 + 240, y0 + 20, { buttons: 0 })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const pb = document.querySelector('#ink path').getBoundingClientRect(); const offset = Math.max(Math.abs(pb.left - x0), Math.abs(pb.top - (y0 - 40)), Math.abs(pb.bottom - (y0 + 40))); return JSON.stringify({ picked, held: MTC.marker.state, strokes: MTC.marker.strokes.length, inkOffsetPx: Math.round(offset) }); })

window.MTC.ready.then(async () => { const at = (t) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, t - performance.now()))); const PM = (x, y) => window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerType: 'mouse', isPrimary: true })); let i = 0; const mover = setInterval(() => { i++; PM(640 + Math.sin(i / 3) * 200, 400 + Math.cos(i / 3) * 120); }, 150); await at(9300); const before = MTC.dog.peekState; await at(11300); clearInterval(mover); const L = MTC.dog.debugPeekLog(); const g = MTC.dog.debugShouldPeek(); const first = L.log[0] || null; const h = MTC.dog.debugPeekHits(); return JSON.stringify({ before, after: MTC.dog.peekState, enteredAt: L.enteredAt, firstPeek: L.firstPeek, shownAfterMs: first && first.shownAt - L.enteredAt, side: first && first.side, idleMs: Math.round(g.gate.idleMs), legacyGateOk: g.ok, hits: h.hits, box: h.box }); })
